title: Let’s have noodles
text:
Let’s have noodles. I thought these were cute, so I ordered them. My husband loves Ramen noodles, so I thought they fit for us.

First of all, these were delivered lightening quick. I was shocked when I received them. They were packaged very well.

They aren’t small single serving bowls. They are serving bowl sized. It does state the size on the listing. They will hold a lot of noodles.

I got the striped ones. I like the print! Simple, but attractive. They are a thick porcelain. Made well. I like the shape. These are good quality bowls.
